description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 tests of problems/heat_1d_periodic.esm (model Heat, test mms_periodic_decay) at the problem's default resolution (N=64) through each binding's official simulation pathway. Exercises the second-order periodic Laplacian rule central_D2_periodic on the manufactured mode exp(-alpha (2 pi)^2 t) cos(2 pi x). The assertions and their tolerances live in the problem file itself; this manifest only routes the runners.
